import json, hashlib, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
expected_head="7bee017a4893ce2ad6f05113bcec9d4f5817c5b7"

def run(args,env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected_head:
    raise SystemExit(f"main moved: {head}")

sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"src"))
from do_again.service.rollout import _tree_hash

source_hash=_tree_hash(repo/"src/do_again")
env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(repo/"src")

p=run(["python3","-m","do_again.cli","upgrade",str(repo),"--apply"],env=env)
print("=== upgrade stdout ===")
print(p.stdout)
print("=== upgrade stderr ===")
print(p.stderr)
print("upgrade_rc="+str(p.returncode))
if p.returncode!=0:
    raise SystemExit(p.returncode)

key=hashlib.sha256(str(repo.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
runtime=root/"runtime/do_again"
state=root/"state"

runtime_hash=_tree_hash(runtime)
try:
    journal=json.loads((state/"runtime_upgrade.json").read_text())
except Exception:
    journal={}

print(json.dumps({
  "repo_head":head,
  "source_hash":source_hash,
  "runtime_hash":runtime_hash,
  "journal":journal,
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))

if runtime_hash!=source_hash:
    raise SystemExit("runtime hash does not match source after upgrade")
if journal.get("state")!="verified":
    raise SystemExit("upgrade journal not verified")
verification=journal.get("verification") or {}
if verification.get("runtime_hash")!=source_hash or verification.get("hash_matches") is not True:
    raise SystemExit("journal verification hash mismatch")
print("SELF_STAGED_UPGRADE_ACCEPTANCE_OK")
